_about: Opening and closing days per winter, found on the web on 2026-11-07 by a research pass (search summaries; items marked fetched were read on the page). Evidence only: scripts/build_dataset.py combines it with the first and last day the operators' own posts name a lift on each side (the union, so no real operating day is cut) and writes data/derived/season_windows_effective.json. 'unconfirmed' means no source was found. Palisades = the Olympic Valley side (Squaw Valley until Sept 2021).

_sides_note: Palisades and Alpine do not always open and close on the same days (Alpine often closes earlier in spring; Palisades has run into May or July 4th in big years). The Base to Base Gondola keeps its own seasonal timeline; build_dataset.py treats it as in season when either side is. General summary supplied by Evan, unverified.
_covid_note: 2019-20 ended with the COVID-19 suspension on 2020-03-15 (posts end 2020-03-14). Winter 2020-21 ran under operating rules (reservations, capacity limits); it is flagged covid_era=restricted and left out of lift-level fits.
